section.content: The invention relates to a lithium ion battery and a manufacturing method thereof, and the lithium ion battery comprises a negative plate, a U-shaped diaphragm plate and a positive plate, wherein the positive plate is wrapped by the U-shaped diaphragm plate, the U-shaped diaphragm plate and the wrapped positive plate are half electrode units formed by hot-pressing composite process treatment, the negative plate and the half electrode units are sequentially stacked to form a basic electrode unit, the basic electrode unit is stacked and wrapped by a diaphragm to form a multi-element electrode unit, the multi-element electrode unit at least comprises two basic electrode units, and the multi-element electrode unit forms a battery monomer; the invention has the advantages of high assembly efficiency and uneasy dislocation.
本发明涉及一种锂离子电池及制造方法，包括负极板、U型隔膜板、正极板，所述正极板被U型隔膜板包裹，所述U型隔膜板和其包裹的正极板是经过热压复合工艺处理形成的一个半电极单元，所述负极板和半电极单元依次堆叠形成一个基本电极单元，所述基本电极单元堆叠并由隔膜包覆形成多元电极单元，所述多元电极单元至少含有两个基本电极单元，所述多元电极单元形成电池单体；本发明具有装配效率高、不易错位的优点。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery technical field, concretely relates to lithium ion battery.

Background

Power lithium ion batteries, which have been attracting attention as power batteries for Electric Vehicles (EV), Hybrid Electric Vehicles (HEV), Parallel Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEV), and the like, which have been proposed as a means for solving air pollution and the like in conventional gasoline vehicles, diesel vehicles, and the like using fossil fuels; the assembly process of the power battery mainly comprises a winding type and a lamination type at present, and the lamination process gradually becomes a mainstream assembly process route of the industry due to the special requirements of the market on high power and high energy of the power battery; however, the existing Z-shaped lamination process or bag type lamination process has two problems of low assembly efficiency and poor safety caused by easy dislocation of electrodes; therefore, it is necessary to provide a lithium ion battery which is highly efficient in assembly and is not easily displaced.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims at overcoming the not enough of prior art, and provide a lithium ion battery that assembly efficiency is high, be difficult for the dislocation.

The purpose of the utility model is realized like this: the lithium ion battery comprises a negative plate, a U-shaped diaphragm plate and a positive plate, wherein the positive plate is wrapped by the U-shaped diaphragm plate, the U-shaped diaphragm plate and the wrapped positive plate are half electrode units formed by hot-pressing compounding, the negative plate and the half electrode units are sequentially stacked to form a basic electrode unit, the basic electrode unit is stacked and wrapped by a diaphragm to form a multi-element electrode unit, the multi-element electrode unit at least comprises two basic electrode units, and the multi-element electrode unit forms a battery monomer.

Coating materials with adhesive force on two side surfaces of the U-shaped diaphragm plate, and adhering the positive plate and the U-shaped diaphragm plate.

Hot-pressing compounding process of U-shaped diaphragm plate and positive plate wrapped by it at 50-150 deg.C and 0-1000Kg/cm of applied pressure2And the time is 0-300 s.

The polarity of the electrode wrapped by the U-shaped diaphragm plate is opposite to that of the adjacent electrode on the outer side, when the wrapped electrode unit is a positive electrode, the two sides of the U-shaped diaphragm plate are negative electrodes, and vice versa.

The surface of the base film of the U-shaped diaphragm plate is also coated with a coating layer of a substance for enhancing the safety of the diaphragm, and the safety substance component is Al2O3And boehmite safety component, and the coating layer of the safety material is single-side coating or double-side coating.

The coating sequence of the coating layer of the U-shaped diaphragm plate is that a safety coating layer is coated firstly, and then adhesive coating layers are coated on two sides of the diaphragm plate.

The coating layer of the U-shaped diaphragm sheet may be formed by mixing an adhesive component and a safety component together and then coating both sides of the diaphragm.

The septum is run one or more times before ending.

The half-electrode unit is formed by bonding the U-shaped diaphragm plate and the positive plate by a hot rolling method.

The electrode wrapped by the U-shaped diaphragm plate is a positive plate or a negative plate, and when the wrapped electrode is the negative plate, the two sides of the U-shaped diaphragm plate are the positive plates.

The half-electrode unit can be used as the first layer on the outer side of the battery cell or the second layer, and the last layer of the battery cell can be used as a negative plate or a positive plate.

The manufacturing method of the lithium ion battery comprises the following steps:

step 1): coating materials with adhesive force on the two side surfaces of the U-shaped diaphragm plate, and adhering the positive plate and the U-shaped diaphragm plate;

step 2): while adhering, heating the positive plate and the U-shaped diaphragm plateTemperature and pressure, i.e. hot-pressing composite process, at 50-150 deg.C and 0-1000Kg/cm of applied pressure2The time is 0 to 300 s;

step 3): the steps are carried out to form a half electrode unit;

step 4): stacking the formed half-electrode units and the opposite electrodes in turn, namely, the electrode polarity wrapped by the U-shaped diaphragm plate is opposite to the polarity of the adjacent electrodes on the outer side, when the wrapped electrode unit is a positive electrode, the two sides of the U-shaped diaphragm plate are negative electrodes, and vice versa, so as to form a basic electrode unit;

step 5): stacking the basic electrode units;

step 6): the diaphragm is closed, the wrapping direction of the diaphragm is clockwise or anticlockwise, and the diaphragm is wrapped along the stacked multi-element electrode units;

step 7): hot-pressing and compounding the multi-element electrode unit after the diaphragm is ended, namely applying temperature, pressure and time to enable the multi-element electrode unit and the diaphragm to form a bonding whole to form a battery monomer, wherein the applying temperature is 50-150 ℃, and the pressure is 0-1000Kg/cm2The time is 0-300s, and the hot rolling line pressing speed is 0-50 m/min.

The length of the diaphragm in the step 6) is more than or equal to the perimeter of the battery cell.

The utility model has the advantages that: the utility model discloses a coating material that has adhesive force of coating side at U type diaphragm plate will just, the negative plate bonds and solves the easy dislocation difficult problem of electrode, and U type diaphragm plate is through hot pressing combined treatment, and the bonding effect is more stable, and the adhesive linkage still coats security material coat, and the security performance of battery is higher, and through piling up many times half electrode and basic electrode unit and forming many units electrode unit, wrap up by the diaphragm again to form battery monomer, great improvement battery monomer's assembly efficiency; the utility model has the advantages of high assembly efficiency and uneasy dislocation.

Drawings

Fig. 1 is a schematic structural view of the half-electrode unit wrapping the positive plate of the present invention.

Fig. 2 is a schematic diagram of the stacked structure of the basic electrode units wrapping the positive plate according to the present invention.

Fig. 3 is a schematic diagram of the structure of the separator wrapping the positive plate according to the present invention.

Fig. 4 is a schematic diagram of the structure of the battery cell wrapping the positive plate of the present invention.

Fig. 5 is a schematic structural view of the half-electrode unit wrapping the negative plate.

Fig. 6 is a schematic diagram of the structure of the membrane wrapping the negative plate of the present invention.

Fig. 7 is a schematic diagram of the structure of the battery cell wrapping the negative plate.

In the figure 1, a positive plate 2, a negative plate 3, a U-shaped separator plate 4 and a separator.

Detailed Description

The present invention will be further described with reference to the accompanying drawings.

Example 1

As shown in fig. 1-7, a lithium ion battery comprises a negative plate 2, a U-shaped separator plate 3, and a positive plate 1, wherein the positive plate 1 is wrapped by the U-shaped separator plate 3, the U-shaped separator plate 3 and the wrapped positive plate 1 are formed into a half-electrode unit through a hot-pressing compounding process, as shown in fig. 1, the negative plate 2 and the half-electrode unit are sequentially stacked to form a basic electrode unit, as shown in fig. 2, the basic electrode unit is stacked and wrapped by a separator 4 to form a multi-electrode unit, as shown in fig. 3, the multi-electrode unit at least comprises two basic electrode units, and the multi-electrode unit forms a battery cell, as shown in fig. 4.

The surface of the base film of the U-shaped diaphragm plate 3 is also coated with a coating layer for enhancing the safety of the diaphragm, the safety material component is at least one or more of Al2O3 and boehmite safety components, the coating layer of the safety material is single-side coating or double-side coating, the coating sequence of the coating layer of the U-shaped diaphragm plate 3 is that the safety coating layer is coated firstly, and then the adhesive coating layer is coated on the two sides of the diaphragm plate, and the coating layer of the U-shaped diaphragm plate 3 can be formed by mixing the adhesive component and the safety component and then coating the two sides of the diaphragm.

Step 7) can be carried out once or more times before the ending of the diaphragm 4, and the length of the diaphragm 4 in step 6) is more than or equal to the perimeter of the battery cell.

The half-electrode unit is formed by bonding the U-shaped diaphragm plate 3 and the positive plate 1 through a hot rolling mode, the electrode wrapped by the U-shaped diaphragm plate 3 is the positive plate 1 and can also be the negative plate 2, when the wrapped U-shaped diaphragm plate 2 is the negative plate 2, the positive plate 1 is arranged on two sides of the U-shaped diaphragm plate 3, the half-electrode unit can be used as the first layer on the outer side of a single battery and can also be used as the second layer, and the last layer of the single battery can be the negative plate 2 and can also be the positive plate 1.

The utility model discloses a coating material that has adhesive force will be just, the negative plate bonds and solves the easy dislocation difficult problem of electrode at U type diaphragm plate 3 side, U type diaphragm plate 3 is through hot pressing combined treatment, the bonding effect is more stable, and the adhesive linkage still coats security material coating, and the security performance of battery is higher, and through piling up many times half electrode and basic electrode unit and forming many electrode unit, wrap up by diaphragm 4 again, thereby form the battery monomer, great improvement the free assembly efficiency of battery; the utility model has the advantages of high assembly efficiency and uneasy dislocation.

Example 2

The utility model discloses a manufacturing method of lithium ion battery, including following step:

step 1): coating materials with adhesive force on the two side surfaces of the U-shaped diaphragm plate, and adhering the positive plate and the U-shaped diaphragm plate;

step 2): applying temperature and pressure to the positive plate and the U-shaped diaphragm plate while bonding, i.e. hot-pressing composite process, wherein the temperature range is 50-150 ℃, and the applied pressure is 0-1000Kg/cm2The time is 0 to 300 s;

step 3): the steps are carried out to form a half electrode unit;

step 4): stacking the formed half-electrode units and the opposite electrodes in turn, namely, the electrode polarity wrapped by the U-shaped diaphragm plate is opposite to the polarity of the adjacent electrodes on the outer side, when the wrapped electrode unit is a positive electrode, the two sides of the U-shaped diaphragm plate are negative electrodes, and vice versa, so as to form a basic electrode unit;

step 5): stacking the basic electrode units;

step 6): the diaphragm is closed, the wrapping direction of the diaphragm is clockwise or anticlockwise, and the diaphragm is wrapped along the stacked multi-element electrode units;

step 7): hot-pressing and compounding the multi-element electrode unit after the diaphragm is ended, namely applying temperature, pressure and time to enable the multi-element electrode unit and the diaphragm to form a bonding whole to form a battery monomer, wherein the applying temperature is 50-150 ℃, and the pressure is 0-1000Kg/cm2The time is 0-300s, and the hot rolling line pressing speed is 0-50 m/min.

The utility model discloses a coating material that has adhesive force will be just, the negative plate bonds and solves the easy dislocation difficult problem of electrode at U type diaphragm plate 3 side, U type diaphragm plate 3 is through hot pressing combined treatment, the bonding effect is more stable, and the adhesive linkage still coats security material coating, and the security performance of battery is higher, and through piling up many times half electrode and basic electrode unit and forming many electrode unit, wrap up by diaphragm 4 again, thereby form the battery monomer, great improvement the free assembly efficiency of battery; the utility model has the advantages of high assembly efficiency and uneasy dislocation.
